buildSentences.display: The students completed their assignments before the deadline.
The scientists discovered a new species in the tropical rainforest.
During the meeting we discussed the upcoming project with enthusiasm.
The team celebrated their victory with a special dinner on Friday.
After the presentation the students asked many thoughtful questions.
The library will be closed for renovation next month.
The professor encouraged the students to participate in the research.
Many people believe that public transportation should be improved in cities.
